cleanup.guest: systemctl --user -M opute@ stop e2e-probe; loginctl disable-linger opute; systemctl stop user@1001.service; for i in $(seq 50); do systemctl -q is-active user-1001.slice || break; sleep 0.2; done; true

description: Negative control for m25: a unit left running in the opute user's manager (the manager itself is declared), undeclared. The observer before m25 did not see it.

inputs.agent: the dev VM's production-style system unit (opute-bootstrap-mcp.service), test identity e2e-devvm-agent, test bearer token

requirements.requirement: Harness: a unit left running in the opute user's manager (the manager itself is declared) is an effect

steps.guest: loginctl enable-linger opute && for i in $(seq 50); do [ -S /run/user/1001/bus ] && break; sleep 0.2; done && systemd-run --user -M opute@ --unit=e2e-probe sleep 3602
